_help: OPTIONAL pre-recorded audio for the read-aloud (speaker) button. Map a string key from web/i18n/strings.json to one mp3 per language, for example  "q.nps": { "hi": "audio/hi/q.nps.mp3", "ta": "audio/ta/q.nps.mp3" }. Paths are relative to the web/ folder. When a clip exists for a text in the partner's language it is played instead of the phone's built-in voice. Keep clips short and small (mono, 32-48 kbps mp3) because partners are on slow data. Leave clips empty to rely on the phone's voice only.
